name: Facebook Block
project_description: Facebook Block provides a single 'Facebook Block' block plugin that renders a Facebook Page plugin (page feed / like box) in any Drupal region. The block admin enters a Facebook ID (page slug) plus a width and height; the block emits the Facebook Page-plugin markup (an fb-root div and an fb-page container with data-href/data-width/data-height attributes) and attaches a small JavaScript loader that injects Facebook's official SDK (connect.facebook.net) to render the embed client-side. Requires only core's Block module; no permissions, config forms, or Drush commands of its own.
